question: Which alkyne with chemical formula CH₃C≡CH appears as a colourless liquefied gas with a sweet odour?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**1-Propyne**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **1-Propyne**, also known as methylacetylene, is a chemical compound with the formula **CH₃C≡CH**.
 
• It is an **alkyne**, which is a hydrocarbon containing a carbon-carbon triple bond, making it unsaturated.
 
• **1-Propyne** is a **colorless liquefied gas** under standard conditions and has a **sweet odor**.
 
• Due to its triple bond, it exhibits **reactivity** in various chemical reactions, such as polymerization and addition reactions.
 
• This compound is part of the **propyne family** and is a common building block in organic synthesis and industrial chemical processes.
 
• It is also used in specialized applications, such as in welding and cutting, where it is blended with **propylene** and other hydrocarbons.
 
• The presence of the **terminal triple bond** makes 1-propyne distinct from other hydrocarbons, including its isomer propadiene.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Ethyne**__

 __
 
• **Ethyne**, commonly known as acetylene, has the chemical formula **C₂H₂**.
 
• It is the simplest alkyne and is widely used as a fuel in welding and cutting processes due to its high flame temperature.
 
• Unlike 1-propyne, ethyne is not a liquefied gas under standard conditions; it exists as a gas at room temperature.
 
 
 
• **1-Hexyne**__
 __
 
• **1-Hexyne** is a higher alkyne with the formula **C₆H₁₀**, containing six carbon atoms.
 
• It is a liquid at room temperature and does not share the sweet odor or gaseous nature of 1-propyne.
 
• It is used in organic synthesis but is not related to applications like 1-propyne.
 
 
 
• **1-Butyne**__
 
 
• **1-Butyne**, with the formula **C₄H₆**, is a smaller alkyne compared to 1-Hexyne but larger than 1-Propyne.
 
• It is a gas at standard conditions but lacks the distinct sweet odor associated with 1-Propyne.
 
• It is used in organic synthesis but is not as commonly encountered as ethyne or 1-propyne.
